profile: Talphera is a specialty pharmaceutical company developing therapies for medically supervised settings. Its portfolio centers on Niyad, a nafamostat formulation under study as a regional anticoagulant for the extracorporeal circuit during continuous renal replacement therapy in hospitalized patients. The company is also exploring LTX-608, a nafamostat formulation for intravenous infusion, for potential use in several acute conditions.
